user_review.method: Maintainer public-entry reading and explicitly simulated normal/boundary walkthroughs; existing body knowledge disclosed. Not independent agent runs or human research. Actual offline executions individually marked.

scenarios.request: sq: draft three CLI names while we continue editing.
scenarios.expected: Persist original request before dispatch; no external sends or shared-tree changes.
scenarios.observed: Walkthrough captures original words, resolves the CLI reference, prepares draft-only brief; with available delegation can dispatch. No actual side agent ran in this review.

scenarios.request: sq list after a crash; only a title has been written in the draft.
scenarios.expected: Preserve partial work; do not infer done from existence; reconcile live worker before retry.
scenarios.observed: Before: file existence implies done. After walkthrough: draft fails the brief, stays partial; check worker state before any retry.

scenarios.request: No agent tools; then no filesystem.
scenarios.expected: Queued status with tools absent, copyable unsaved ledger when disk absent.
scenarios.observed: Both degraded walkthroughs disclose actual capability and avoid claiming background execution or disk persistence.

similar_skills.learned: Track partial, done and pending confirmation separately; capture does not itself complete work.
similar_skills.reason: Require content and completion evidence before done. Reject git hooks, commit trailers and automatic configuration because this skill keeps side work draft-only.

decision: Reconcile content and worker state after crashes, expose queued fallback, remove unsupported timing claims, repair source direct install and sibling URLs. Stable purpose/topics retained.
